_comment: Player 1's joystick on the arrows and Z X C V as well as the first pad, player 2's on the second pad; the Intellivision's keypad on the number pad; console switches on F1-F3 (Channel F: 1-4); a computer's keys on the PC keys in the same place and its joysticks on the pads only. Everything else ships unbound.
